plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says an FBI document from the 1940s, now circulating, describes the scientist Thomas Townsend Brown, whom Michels links to gravity research, as the lead radar scientist in the entire US Navy, knowing more about radar than anyone else there. Michels adds that he thinks there is good evidence Brown's work ended up in the B-2, the US stealth bomber. He tells it to show that Brown's unusual ideas had serious weight inside the military.
